messages.author: 44e88d964e317aa3
messages.subject: Plot size error in placement
parts:
Hi everyone

I have problems when I use the plotsize function in fieldshape_render()

if I just make simple fieldshape it puts the plots right in the orientation of the plots

EX1.Shape<-fieldShape_render(mosaic = EX1,ncols = 4, nrows = 4)

But if I use the plotsize it place the plots in not straight.

It is making orientation north/south even the plots are not north/south

Anyone who knows why and how to fix

Please see attached for pictures and code

kind regards Martin Gejl

messages.subject: Re: Plot size error in placement
parts:
Hey there, fieldShape_render XY is working for diagonal field trials now!

Everyone needs to install again FIELDimageR.Extra using RStudio: https://github.com/filipematias23/FIELDimageR.Extra?tab=readme-ov-file#instal 

Also, if you want to instal FIELDimageR-QGIS: https://github.com/filipematias23/FIELDimageR-QGIS?tab=readme-ov-file#instal

Hope it helps..!

All the best,
Filipe and Popat
